name: Haven
english_description: A long-running Dead Souls-based game (self-titled 'Haven', world name 'Kailie') with a large, genuinely bespoke world: 21 custom domains, a full in-game pantheon and history timeline, marriage/estate/crafting/newsgroup/FTP subsystems, and 25 personal wizard workrooms under realms/. Not a stock demo -- the shared Dead Souls engine layer is a thin base under a decade-plus of original room, NPC, and quest content.
